skills.author: michaelweissdev
skills.name: conventional-commits
skills.description: Write, review, validate, and organize precise Conventional Commits 1.0.0 messages from actual code changes. Use when the user asks for a commit message, wants to commit changes, reviews commit history, prepares a clean commit series, or needs guidance on commit types, scopes, breaking changes, release impact, or commit-message compliance. Inspect the real diff and repository conventions before composing messages; never infer changes from filenames alone.
skills.compatibility: Works with Claude Code and other Agent Skills-compatible coding agents. Git is helpful for repository inspection but not required when a diff is provided.
